description: Normalized, lower-level observations about one finding. These are the ONLY inputs to authoritative classification. They are facts, not conclusions: the backend computes confidence score, band, corroboration and status from them. The closed vocabulary is defined by the finding-policy specification named in engine.finding_policy_version; which facts are mandatory is decided there, not here, so a missing fact is an unclassifiable finding (INCOMPLETE) rather than a malformed submission.

analyzer_implementation.description: Implementation class of the analyzer that produced the finding.

auth_expectation.description: What an authoritative source (for example an OpenAPI security requirement) declared about authentication for the affected endpoint.

corroborating_tools.description: Identities of independent tools that reported the same normalized weakness at the same normalized location. Non-empty exactly when cross_tool_corroborated is true.

cross_tool_corroborated.description: An independent tool reported the same normalized weakness at the same normalized location.

dependency_applicability.description: Whether the vulnerable component of a dependency advisory is used by the scanned code.

direct_observation.description: The claim is a deterministic read of a single live response (a header, cookie attribute or CORS value present or absent).

fixture_shaped_value.description: The matched credential value matches the deterministic fixture/placeholder heuristics.

in_test_code.description: Every occurrence of the finding lies in test or fixture code.

observation_source.description: How the finding was observed: static analysis, live analysis, both independently, or an imported external report.

payload_validated.description: An active probe's payload elicited the response the check predicted. The payload and response themselves are never submitted.

proven_path.description: A live request confirmed the route AND a reachable taint path to the sink was proven.

provider_anchored_secret.description: The matched credential value carries a known provider's signature (for example an AKIA access-key id).

reachable_taint_path.description: Static analysis proved a source-to-sink taint path.

response_context.description: Context of the live response the finding fired on.

route_confirmed.description: A live request confirmed the vulnerable route.

rule_precision.description: The emitting rule's declared detection precision: a static property of the rule (a literal match versus a graded heuristic), not a conclusion about this finding.

unconfirmed_by_live_scan.description: Correlation ran against a live scan and did not confirm this finding.

title: Normalized evidence facts
